```{r}
source("R/site.R")
d = courses()
now = current_courses(d)
reg = d[d$kind == "regular", ]
# one row per course, however its number changed: matched on the title
reg$key = tolower(sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)$", "", reg$title))
course_rows = function(inst) {
  r = reg[reg$institution == inst, ]
  out = character(0)
  for (k in unique(r$key)) {
    x = r[r$key == k, ]
    nums = unique(sub("-\\d+$|[A-Z]$", "", x$number))
    href = x$url[!is.na(x$url)][1]
    out = c(out, paste0('<tr><td>', link(txt(x$title[1]), href), '</td>',
                        '<td>', h(paste(nums, collapse = ", ")), '</td>',
                        '<td class="terms">', paste(h(paste(x$term, x$year)), collapse = ", "), '</td></tr>'))
  }
  paste0('<table class="courses-taught"><thead><tr><th>Course</th><th>Number</th><th>Taught</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
         paste(out, collapse = ""), '</tbody></table>')
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (nrow(now)) {
  t = term_of()
  emit('<h2>', t$term, ' ', t$year, '</h2><ul class="course-cards">',
       paste0('<li class="course-card"><div class="course-number">', link(h(now$number), now$url),
              '</div><div class="course-title">', txt(now$title), '</div></li>', collapse = ""),
       '</ul>')
}
for (inst in unique(reg$institution)) emit('<h2>', txt(inst), '</h2>', course_rows(inst))
sh = d[d$kind == "short", ]
emit('<h2>Short courses</h2><ul>',
     paste0('<li>', vapply(seq_len(nrow(sh)), function(i) link(txt(sh$title[i]), sh$url[i]), ""),
            ', ', txt(sh$institution), ' (', h(sh$term), ' ', sh$year,
            ifelse(is.na(sh$duration), '', paste0(', ', h(sh$duration))), ')</li>', collapse = ""),
     '</ul>')
```
